name: Write in a language you are learning
description: Write a short text of your own in a language you are learning, and mark what you are not sure of. This is not translation and not a separate skill for each language.
emoji_rationale: The note stands for a short text you write yourself.

levels.name: Say one thing in writing
levels.completion_criterion: Write a few sentences on a familiar topic and check that they say what you meant.
levels.can_do: You can produce a short text you can explain.
levels.safety_requirements: No particular language is required. Do not present this as translation.

levels.name: Revise for a reader
levels.completion_criterion: Rewrite the same point so a reader who shares the language can follow it, using a reference you trust for words you could not recall.
levels.can_do: You can improve clarity without changing the point.
levels.safety_requirements: A dictionary check is a reference, not a claim that the text is error-free.

levels.name: Mark uncertainty
levels.completion_criterion: Write a short note for a real reader and mark the words or sentences you are not sure of.
levels.can_do: You can show the limit of what you can write.
levels.safety_requirements: Do not hide a guess as a finished sentence.

safety_notes: Pilot only. Not a translation skill and not language-specific.

name: Read a technical drawing
description: Read a technical drawing well enough to name the parts, use a stated measurement, and say what the drawing does not tell you.
emoji_rationale: The ruler stands for reading a measurement on a drawing, not for making the drawing.

levels.name: Name the parts
levels.completion_criterion: From one technical drawing, name the main parts it shows.
levels.can_do: You can say what is drawn.
levels.safety_requirements: Do not operate a machine from the drawing.

levels.name: Use a stated measurement
levels.completion_criterion: Read one dimension, including its unit, and say which part it belongs to.
levels.can_do: You can use a measurement that is actually printed.
levels.safety_requirements: Do not invent a dimension that is not on the drawing.

levels.name: State the limit
levels.completion_criterion: Say one thing a person would still need to know before making or ordering the object.
levels.can_do: You can separate the drawing from what it leaves out.
levels.safety_requirements: Reading a drawing is not permission to carry out a hazardous process.

safety_notes: Pilot only. Do not treat the drawing as instructions for hazardous work.

name: Edit a shared document
description: Change a document that someone else can also edit, without erasing their point, and leave a trace of what you changed.
emoji_rationale: Two people stand for editing the same document together.

levels.name: Make one visible change
levels.completion_criterion: In a shared practice document, add or edit a passage the other person can see.
levels.can_do: You can change a shared document.
levels.safety_requirements: Use a document you are allowed to edit.

levels.name: Keep the other person's point
levels.completion_criterion: Make a change that responds to their text and leave their point still visible.
levels.can_do: You can add to someone else's work without replacing it.
levels.safety_requirements: Do not delete their contribution to make the document look like yours alone.

levels.name: Leave a trace
levels.completion_criterion: Leave the document so a third person can tell what you changed and what was already there.
levels.can_do: You can separate your edit from the earlier text.
levels.safety_requirements: The trace can be a comment, a suggestion, or the tool's history. The ESCO description does not require one product.
